items.alt: A ChatGPT user stares at his screen as a sponsored sunscreen ad appears beside the golden retriever picture he asked for, while a suited ad man looks on.
Harmanpreet Kaur, bat in hand, leaves the captain's armband on a stand marked Next Captain beside her World Cup trophy and Asian Games medals.
Rahul Gandhi climbs a Delhi Police barricade with the national flag outside the Election Commission as opposition MPs are led to police buses.
Pakistani and Turkish soldiers carry a defence pact marked First Time towards Saudi Arabia as an Indian tanker sails anxiously near Bab el-Mandeb.
